title: Google Removes Gemini Pro from Free and Plus Plans on Oct 9

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Access to advanced artificial intelligence models is becoming more restricted within the Gemini ecosystem. Starting Oct 9, Google will limit access to its Gemini Pro models exclusively to subscribers of the AI Pro and AI Ultra plans. Users on the free tier will be limited to the Flash-Lite model, while AI Plus subscribers will lose Pro access and be restricted to the Flash model. In a partial expansion of benefits, the AI Pro tier will now include the Deep Think feature, which was previously available only to Ultra users.

The realignment of subscription tiers comes as Google prepares for the launch of the Gemini 4 Argon model. The upcoming model is more expensive to operate than previous versions, which may have prompted the company to move higher-tier models behind the most expensive paid subscriptions, according to market commentary.
